Defence, Government of India.  
Proof : https://idex.gov.in/node/315

2019 Competition held at Kolkata [“BEV in your hands” Project].

Awards-2020 held at Hyderabad [“Smart Agri Assistant” project].

“Estimation of Energy Consumption using AI & ML”.
